title: We Can Choose to Get Back on Track
author: The Daily Dad
summary: The Daily Dad offers a reminder that parents can choose, at any moment, to return to the standard they wish to live by. Drawing on Stoic philosophy and practical wisdom, the devotional acknowledges parental failure and offers the freedom of immediate choice. Perfect is not required; better, starting now, is always available.
points: Parents cannot change the past; they can only choose what happens next. Falling short does not require a season of pity; it requires a moment of choice and immediate action. The standard you want to live by as a parent is always accessible in the present moment. Like physical fitness, parental discipline requires returning to the pattern after lapses, not self-condemnation. The job of parenting matters immensely, and parents are not alone in the struggle to live up to their own ideals.
quotes: There's nothing you can do now to undo it. The question is, how do you move forward?
We have the power, at any moment, to get back on track.
No parent has time to indulge in pity parties.
We can choose right now to get back on track. We can choose right now to do better.
